'''Gixsa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Corellian who fought as a defender of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
In [[3640 BBY]], during the [[Battle of Corellia]] Gixsa was called along with a group of Corellian defenders to meet with [[Darmas Pollaran]] in [[supply tunnel 26]] and blow up a hole in it. Gixsa and other resistance fighters have gathered in the tunnel and were listen to Pollaran's speech in preparation for detonating the charges when a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as [[Voidhound]] interrupted the gathering. Pollaran tried to frame the newcomer as the agent of the [[Harridax Kirill|Voidwolf]], but was revealed as an Imperial himself instead when Gixsa pointed out that nobody knew the man calling himself a true Corellian. Pollaran send [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] against the resistance while escaping in confusion.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
